product.name: Monoprice RVC50-70 50-Watt 70V Rotary Speaker Volume Control
product.description: The RVC50‑70 is an in‑wall, inline volume control for 70V music systems. It features 11 volume positions with make before break contacts. It supports a maximum load of 50 watts and can fit into a single gang junction box, while two RVC50‑70 volume controls or one RVC25‑70 and one RVC‑50‑70 can fit side‑by‑side into a dual gang box.Support Files: Quick Install Guide (Jul 3, 2019)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. Updated Mar 9, 2022 Warning: This product can expose you to Phthalates, which is known to the State of California to cause cancer and reproductive harm. For more information, go to www.P65Warnings.ca.gov
